name: Autocam Medical
old_description: A global contract manufacturer of orthopedic implants, spinal implants, precision instruments and orthopedic cutting tools.
about:
Autocam Medical is a privately held contract manufacturer headquartered in Warsaw, Indiana. The company operates globally with a 100,000-square-foot global headquarters and manufacturing facility in Kentwood, Michigan, plus additional operations in Plymouth, Massachusetts; Murfreesboro, Tennessee; and Suzhou, China.

The company specializes in precision-machined components for orthopedic and spinal procedures, producing surgical drill bits, drivers, screws, plates, cutting tools, implants, instruments, handpieces, and other device components. Its core processes include CNC milling, CNC turning, and cutter grinding, supported by design-for-manufacturing engineering. The new $60 million Kentwood facility is expected to create 250 jobs and expands the company’s manufacturing footprint in West Michigan.

Autocam Medical serves medical device manufacturers whose products are used in spine, foot and ankle, hand and wrist, hip and knee, shoulder and elbow, and craniomaxillofacial procedures. Its customers are typically original equipment manufacturers in the orthopedic and surgical instrument markets.

The company emphasizes a value-added approach to high-precision manufacturing, leveraging proprietary processes and state-of-the-art equipment built to its own specifications. Design-for-manufacturing engineering is integrated early to add value across the entire production cycle.

name: AutohausAZ
old_description: Though we’ve been selling car parts online since 2000, the Autohaus brand has been around since 1979. We first began selling parts for Euro cars in the late 1970’s. Back then, we specialized in Volvo replacement parts and distributing all Euro parts for Bosch throughout the Arizona valley. Fast forward to present day, and we are selling auto parts online exclusively to millions of do-it-yourselfers worldwide. Just because you find cheap auto parts on our website, we assure each and every one of our customers that we only carry, stock, and ship OEM quality new parts. You’ll never have to worry about getting used European parts from us.
about:
AutohausAZ traces its roots to 1979, when it opened as Autohaus Phoenix in Phoenix, Arizona. The business began by supplying European auto parts to local repair shops in the Phoenix valley, initially specializing in Volvo replacement parts and distributing Bosch components.

Today the company operates as a large-scale online distributor of OEM and OE-quality replacement parts for European vehicles, including BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Audi, Volkswagen, Volvo, Saab, Land Rover, and Mercedes Sprinter models. A nationwide warehouse network enables same-day shipment on orders placed before 1 PM Mountain Standard Time, and the catalog is maintained by in-house specialists who verify fitment across year, make, model, and submodel.

The customer base spans individual do-it-yourselfers and professional repair shops worldwide, with the company serving hundreds of thousands of accounts. Its focus remains on the European automotive aftermarket, providing parts ranging from filters and brake components to engine and transmission components.

AutohausAZ emphasizes direct purchasing to keep prices 20 to 90 percent below retail, backs every part with a three-year/36-month warranty, and offers flexible financing for larger repairs. The combination of a fitment-verified catalog, same-day fulfillment, and a no-hassle return policy is presented as the core differentiator.

name: Autokiniton - Greenville
old_description: Autokiniton US Holdings, Inc. today announced the completion of its acquisition of Tower International, Inc. (NYSE: TOWR) (“Tower”), a leading manufacturer of engineered automotive structural metal components and assemblies, for $31 per share in cash. AGG is a subsidiary of Autokiniton Global Group, LP, a portfolio company of KPS Capital Partners, LP (“KPS”), a leading global private equity firm with approximately $5.1 billion of assets under management, as of June 30, 2019.
about:
Autokiniton’s Greenville operation is part of a global automotive supplier formed in May 2018 when KPS Capital Partners and George Thanopoulos created Autokiniton Global Group (AGG) to acquire L&W Group, a Tier 1 specialist in metal stampings, welded assemblies, and tubular products. The combined entity, headquartered in Fountain Inn, South Carolina, grew through the September 2019 acquisition of Tower International, creating the second-largest body-in-white and vehicle-frame supplier in North America with $2.3 billion in annual sales.

The company manufactures high-strength structural components and precision stampings for vehicle bodies and frames. Additional capabilities include tube forming on three mills, roll forming on two mills, laser cutting with 40 lasers, and custom tool and die development.

Autokiniton serves the automotive industry as a Tier 1 supplier to the world’s automakers, including Ford (which awarded it a World Excellence Award in 2021). Its propulsion-agnostic components go into electric vehicles, internal-combustion cars, minivans, and pickup trucks. The company also supplies tubing for the trailer and recreational-vehicle markets.

The firm emphasizes streamlined, bureaucracy-free problem solving and strategic plant placement near customer assembly sites to reduce logistics costs. Its differentiation rests on joining dissimilar metals (aluminum, hot-formed and ultra-high-strength steels) at scale, backed by a quality lab performing crush, tensile, and metallurgical testing.

name: Autoliv North America Inc (OTC)
old_description: Autoliv has developed its first complete wearable protection for motorcycle riders: a vest with an integrated airbag system designed to reduce critical injury risks in the event of a crash. This system is now being launched in collaboration with RS Taichi, a leading manufacturer of motorcycle riding gear, who will bring it to market.
about:
Autoliv North America Inc is headquartered in Ogden, Utah. The company operates as the North American arm of Autoliv, a global automotive safety supplier with operations in 25 countries and 13 technical centers worldwide. No founding year or founder names are provided in the public materials.

Autoliv develops, manufactures, and markets passive safety systems including airbags, seatbelts, and steering wheels for virtually all major automotive manufacturers. The company also produces mobility safety solutions such as a wearable airbag vest for motorcycle riders, developed in collaboration with gear maker RS Taichi. Its product portfolio includes pyrotechnical safety switches for short-circuit prevention, the HBM Safety Suite, and components critical to airbag ignition and deployment. Autoliv operates 13 technical centers with 20 test tracks and offers specialized test services tailored to industry needs. The global workforce numbers approximately 64,000 employees, and the company reported $10.8 billion in net sales for 2025 with a 44 percent market share.

The primary customers are automotive OEMs across passenger and commercial vehicle segments. Autoliv also serves the motorcycle safety market through partnerships with riding-gear manufacturers like RS Taichi. Recent collaborations include agreements with XPENG and Great Wall Motor to advance safer mobility worldwide. The company’s safety solutions address the entire mobility chain, from traditional vehicles to emerging multi-modal transport.

Autoliv states its vision as "Saving More Lives," with a long-standing ambition for its products to save 100,000 lives per year and to achieve carbon-neutral operations by 2030. The company emphasizes digitalization and automation as cornerstones of operational excellence, and highlights its history of delivering virtually all major technological breakthroughs in automotive safety.

name: Automated Food Systems
old_description: We build high-performance Food Processing Systems for the production of
about:
Automated Food Systems is based in Waxahachie, Texas, and was founded in 1976 by mechanical engineer Glenn Walser with a single investor. The company began when a food processor needed a way to automate corn dog production — a challenge others said could not be solved — and Walser developed the world’s first automated corndog system.

Today the company designs, manufactures, and integrates custom food processing and material handling equipment for stick and skewered foods. Its product line includes corn dog systems running at 3,000 to 16,000 units per hour, kebab and skewer systems up to 4,080 units per hour, funnel cake systems, industrial batter mixers (60 to 180 gallon capacities), food pumps rated to 223 GPM, and food‑grade skewers and sticks. A history of over 20 distinct machine models — from the early PRL‑400 semi‑automated system to the KW‑2001 high‑speed skewering system — shows a deep, iterative engineering focus.

Customers range from small producers to the largest multi‑national food processing companies worldwide. Installations operate in plants across North America, South America, Africa, Europe, Asia, and Australia, serving the industrial food manufacturing, stick and skewered food, and concession sectors.

The company emphasizes problem‑solving for unique food automation challenges, citing its 40‑plus years of experience, custom design flexibility, and a service model that includes dedicated parts inventory, lifetime support, on‑site training during startup, and plant layout optimization. It positions itself as a partner that treats every customer as if it had a million competitors.

about:
Automotive Charging & Starting LLC was founded in 2011 by Brian Webb in Idaho Falls, Idaho. Webb brought over 20 years of experience from AC&S to establish an independently owned and operated shop focused on automotive electrical systems

The company provides battery sales, service, and recycling, along with repair and rebuilding of alternators, starters, generators, and DC motors. It maintains a large inventory of parts from OEM and aftermarket suppliers such as Delco, Bosch, Denso, and Mitsubishi, and offers same-day completion for most jobs unless parts must be ordered. A 24-hour emergency service, free battery checks, free installation, and a battery buy-back program round out the offering.

The shop serves automotive, commercial, industrial, agricultural, marine, recreational, and truck customers across a wide range of brands, including Japanese, European, and domestic manufacturers from Acura to Volvo and from Chrysler to Ford.

Webb started the business to deliver value to the community through outstanding service, a no-hassle guarantee, and free diagnostics for no-start conditions, aiming to recommend the least expensive solution rather than replace unnecessary parts.

name: Automotive Equipment of Nevada
old_description: AEN has been serving the automotive industry for over 34 years. We are a full-service automotive shop equipment distributor, selling and servicing the top-tier automotive shop equipment brands.
about:
Automotive Equipment of Nevada (AEN) operates from Las Vegas, Nevada. The company was founded in 2006, though it reports more than 34 years of experience serving the automotive aftermarket. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

AEN functions as a full-service distributor of automotive shop equipment, representing manufacturers. Its offerings span individual items such as jacks and alignment systems up to complete frame-pulling bays. Beyond sales, the firm provides design services for ground-up dealership construction and major remodels, coordinating with general contractors early to prevent costly change orders. A service division with over 20 years of repair experience handles everything from stuck lifts to leaking oil lines, while an installation team fits equipment ranging from single oil reels to dealerships with more than 80 in-ground lifts.

The primary customers are automotive dealerships, independent repair shops, and general contractors involved in facility projects. AEN’s work includes outfitting new dealership builds and supporting remodels for existing service centers.

The company emphasizes a single-source model: because it installs what it sells, it asserts that all components work together harmoniously. Nevada contractor licenses 86133 and 86134 underscore its compliance with state regulations for construction-related installations.

name: Automotive Supply Center
old_description: Automotive Supply Center (ASC) has served the Hilo community since 1955. Our inventory of new and rebuilt automotive parts, supplies, and paint means you can be sure to find everything for a foreign or domestic car, truck, and high-performance vehicles. ASC is the auto parts shop to equip your vehicle and keep it running at optimum performance. We also have three warehouses stocked with a variety of automotive parts to serve you.
about:
Automotive Supply Center (ASC) has operated in Hilo, Hawaii since 1955. Founded by brothers Kazuichi and Hayato Okino, the business began with five employees on Piopio Street. A 1960 tsunami destroyed the original shop, prompting a move to Kanoelehua Industrial Park and later to its current location at 411 E Kawili St. in 1996. Today, the company remains family-run under Peter Okino and his son Darin Okino, who oversee a staff of over 35.

ASC functions as a distributor and retailer of automotive parts and accessories, stocking new and rebuilt components for domestic and imported cars, light trucks, heavy trucks, and 4x4 vehicles. Its three warehouses carry motor parts, electrical components, air-conditioning parts, batteries, detailing products, body supplies, fluids, tools, and equipment. The inventory spans thousands of part numbers across passenger and commercial vehicle lines.

The company serves the entire Big Island, supplying individual vehicle owners, independent repair shops, and fleet operators. Its customer base includes owners of foreign and domestic cars, light and heavy trucks, and high-performance vehicles. Staff assist with part identification for specific makes, models, years, engines, and drivetrains.

ASC attributes its longevity to a knowledgeable workforce, many recruited from Hawaii Community College’s auto body and repair programs, with several employees exceeding 30 years of tenure. The company emphasizes breadth of inventory and personalized service as its competitive foundation.

about:
Founded in 1981 as a family-owned business in Baltimore, Maryland, Avalon Industries operates two distinct divisions under common ownership. The company began as a manufacturer of soft-sided carrying cases and has since expanded to include a promotional products division.

The manufacturing division produces soft-sided carrying cases, bags, totes, and molded laminate cases designed to hold and transport supplies and equipment for commercial and military applications. The second division, Avalon Promotional Products, functions as an advertising specialties distributor, supplying personalized apparel, uniforms, and branded merchandise for corporate and organizational identity programs.

Avalon’s customer base spans the U.S. defense department, first-responder agencies, public schools, municipal governments, youth sports leagues, and the broader commercial marketplace. Both divisions have supplied these sectors for several years, providing custom carrying solutions and branded promotional items tailored to each end user.

The dual-division structure allows the company to address procurement needs ranging from rugged transport cases for military gear to embroidered uniforms for local sports teams, all managed from a single family-owned operation in the Mid-Atlantic region.

name: Avon Food Company
old_description: Founded by family, now led by the next generation, Avon Food Co. blends heritage, innovation, and SQF-certified precision to bring bold flavors to shelves nationwide.
about:
Avon Food Company operates from a 55,000-square-foot facility in Stoughton, Massachusetts. The business was founded in 2002 by Stephen and Heidee Anastos as a small family-run operation focused on sauces, dressings, and marinades. Today, the company is led by their son, Michael Anastos, who has expanded the operation while maintaining its family-owned character.

The company manufactures liquid and dry food products, including sauces, dressings, marinades, and custom spice blends. Its services span research and development, liquid manufacturing, spice blending, storage and delivery, quality and compliance, and full private-label manufacturing. Four dedicated production lines handle a range of viscosities and formats: an electromagnetic filler for high-speed liquid filling, pressure overflow and piston fillers for versatile sauces and dressings, an auger filler for dry spices, and a line for 5-gallon pail and bag-in-box packaging. The facility employs 35-plus people and produces more than 300 distinct items.

Avon Food serves established brands and startups across North America, providing private-label manufacturing and co-packing for the specialty food, sauce, dressing, marinade, and spice-blend categories. Customers include wholesale and private-label partners who rely on the company's nationwide shipping and regional delivery options.

The Anastos family started the business with a vision of creating exceptional products made with care and consistency. The company emphasizes its SQF-certified, HACCP-compliant processes, scalable production from small batches to large runs, and a partnership-first approach that includes in-house recipe development and ingredient sourcing.
